text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth got injured during 
training, so I rushed her to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I got carried away by the ritmo and had a 
bit too much fun.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Doloroso. I am at my wit's end...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Trainer, may I request a song from you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure if you listen to musica, the pain 
will ease up.
choice_data_list: No, let's rest quietly for now.

I'm not used to this, but I'll give it a 
try!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I'm sorry for making such 
an inconsiderate request.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Even though your Melodia was crying out 
that you weren't in the mood for that 
right now..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I ended up leaning on your kindness, using 
my injury as an excuse.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fermata. For now, I shall rest and take it 
easy.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. An injury like this is 
nothing, I'll bounce right back in no 
time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to have Sounds of Earth 
take a break and rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping it would cheer them up, they 
cheerfully shook their maracas with a 
rhythmic ch-ch-ch.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It has a very beautiful ring to it, full 
of warmth and compassion.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I can't take it anymore...! Just a 
little bit, just a short session is all I 
ask."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If it's just clapping along... okay? 
Clap... clap-clap... clap... clap-clap♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Haha... My 'passionato' overflowed a bit 
too much...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How foolish of me. Truly foolish... I'll 
just rest quietly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth's injury worsened, forcing 
her to take a break for a while.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Strangely, the pain begins to fade away 
too.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Hup... there. Yep, doesn't hurt at all.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This is the infinite potential that Musica 
holds...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: No, perhaps it's the power of your amore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps aided by her music, Sounds of 
Earth was able to make a smooth recovery.
